Database.Error saveError = failedSave.errors[0]; System.assertEquals(StatusCode.REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, saveError.statusCode); System.assert(saveError.message.length() > 0); System.assert(saveError.fields.contains('Name')); Account savedRow = new Account(Name = 'Wave 18 Saved'); Database.SaveResult saved = Database.insert(savedRow, false); Account otherSavedRow = new Account(Name = 'Wave 18 Other Saved'); Database.SaveResult otherSaved = Database.insert(otherSavedRow, false); System.assertEquals(true, saved.success); System.assertEquals(savedRow.Id, saved.id); System.assertEquals(false, saved.equals(otherSaved)); Integer savedHash = saved.hashCode(); System.assertEquals(savedHash, saved.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(savedHash, otherSaved.hashCode()); System.assert(saved.toString().length() > 0); Account upsertFailedRow = new Account(); Database.UpsertResult upsertFailed = Database.upsert(upsertFailedRow, false); System.assertEquals(upsertRow.Id, upserted.id); System.assertEquals(false, upserted.equals(upsertedUpdate)); Integer upsertedHash = upserted.hashCode(); System.assertEquals(upsertedHash, upserted.hashCode()); System.assertEquals(master.Id, merged.id); System.assertEquals(1, merged.mergedrecordids.size()); System.assertEquals(duplicate.Id, merged.mergedrecordids[0]); System.assertEquals(1, merged.updatedrelatedids.size()); System.assertEquals(child.Id, merged.updatedrelatedids[0]); System.assertEquals(false, merged.equals(mergedTwo)); Integer mergedHash = merged.hashCode(); System.assertEquals(mergedHash, merged.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(mergedHash, mergedTwo.hashCode()); System.assert(merged.toString().length() > 0); Account recycle = new Account(Name = 'Wave 18 Recycle'); insert recycle; Account recycleTwo = new Account(Name = 'Wave 18 Recycle Two'); Integer deletedHash = deleted.hashCode(); System.assertEquals(deletedHash, deleted.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(deletedHash, deletedTwo.hashCode()); System.assert(deleted.toString().length() > 0); Database.UndeleteResult restored = Database.undelete(recycle, false); Database.UndeleteResult restoredTwo = Database.undelete(recycleTwo, false); System.assertEquals(false, restored.equals(restoredTwo)); Integer restoredHash = restored.hashCode(); System.assertEquals(restoredHash, restored.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(restoredHash, restoredTwo.hashCode()); System.assert(restored.toString().length() > 0); Database.delete(recycle, false); Database.delete(recycleTwo, false); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult emptied = Database.emptyRecycleBin(recycle); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult emptiedTwo = Database.emptyRecycleBin(recycleTwo); System.assertEquals(true, emptied.success); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, emptied.id); System.assertEquals(false, emptied.equals(emptiedTwo)); Integer emptiedHash = emptied.hashCode(); System.assertEquals(emptiedHash, emptied.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(emptiedHash, emptiedTwo.hashCode()); System.assert(emptied.toString().length() > 0);
